mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 5-year average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST growth > 0 and RSAFS growth > 0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 indicates a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 103.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Higher monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST is above its 3-month average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO is above its 3-month average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
